description_en: Call DescribeEnsEipAddresses to query elastic IP addresses (EIPs)
kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-ens-eip-addresses --allocation-id eip-5q9uwkd9bznjpxz8hr6cirnjk --eip-address 120.XXX.XXX.4 --associated-instance-id lb-5t18quoohsrc3xkf86spmnu77 --associated-instance-type SlbInstance --status InUse --ens-region-id cn-chengdu-telecom --eip-name test --standby true --icmp-reply-enabled false --ens-region-ids cn-chengdu-telecom-4 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --lock-reason financial --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEnsEipAddresses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP instance. You can specify up to 50 IDs, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP实例的ID。  最多支持输入50个EIP实例ID，实例ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the EIP. You can specify up to 50 IP addresses, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP的IP地址。  最多支持输入50个EIP的IP地址，IP地址之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: eip_address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated cloud service instance
parameters.name: associated_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud service instance to associate with the EIP. Valid values:

EnsInstance: an ENS instance of the VPC type.

SlbInstance: an SLB instance
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的云产品实例的类型，取值： 

EnsInstance：VPC类型的ENS实例。

SlbInstance：负载均衡实例
parameters.name: associated_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the EIP. Valid values: Associating, Unassociating, InUse, and Available
parameters.help_zh: EIP的状态，取值：  Associating：绑定中。 Unassociating：解绑中。 InUse：已分配。 Available：可用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the EIP is a standby EIP. Valid values:

true: The EIP is a standby EIP.

false: The EIP is not a standby EIP
parameters.help_zh:
是否备用弹性IP。取值：

true：备用。

false：非备用
parameters.name: standby

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ICMP reply. Valid values:

true (default): enabled

false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启ICMP代回。取值：

true（默认值）：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: icmp_reply_enabled

parameters.help_en: An array of 1 to 100 ENS node IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The reason the EIP is locked.

financial: The EIP is locked due to an overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
锁定类型。
financial：因欠费被锁定
parameters.name: lock_reason
